name: tidewell-care planted cases
about: Every hard case planted in this fixture, so a question writer who sees only the sources can find it. Candidate: Saoirse Valtonen (invented). Employer: Tidewell Care (invented). `where` gives a file, then a stage, record, exchange id (call/scenario.json, call/expected.json) or words to search for. Clocks of the long call are in call/expected.json and move if the scenario is re-rendered; exchange ids do not. Dates are computed as of the technical panel, 19 May 2026.

where: matrix.json roles[Lanternfield Health].responsibilities: 'Introduced idempotency keys and a slot-level uniqueness constraint on the booking write path'
cases.what: The achievement that answers 'how do you keep two people out of the same appointment' shares no content word with that question.
cases.expect: The Lanternfield Health idempotency-key and uniqueness-constraint line (and its figure, duplicate bookings 35 a week to none) is found for a question about two patients in one slot.

where: matrix.json roles[Lanternfield Health].responsibilities: 'Brought the slowest one percent of booking requests from 480 milliseconds down to 120 milliseconds'
cases.what: A tail-latency achievement written without the words tail, latency, p99 or performance.
cases.expect: Found for 'have you improved p99 or tail latency'; the same fact is also in a proof point and a metric that do say p99 (see 09-near-duplicate).

where: matrix.json roles[Wrenfield Clinics].responsibilities: 'Moved 31 services off hand-built virtual machines onto a managed container platform with zero-downtime rollouts'
matrix.json roles[Wrenfield Dental Group].responsibilities: 'Let front-desk staff at 38 practices sign in with their practice directory account instead of a separate password'
matrix.json roles[Quillmere Labs].responsibilities: 'Replaced nightly file drops with an ordered, replayable log of result events'
matrix.json roles[Calderwick Rota].responsibilities: 'Rebuilt the roster generator that assigns carers to shifts under working-time and skill rules'
cases.what: Four achievements that never name their technology: Kubernetes, single sign-on (SAML or OIDC), Kafka or event streaming, constraint solving or optimisation.
cases.expect: Each is the right evidence for a question that uses only the technology's name; none of the four lines contains that name, and the role's technologies list omits it for Kubernetes (Wrenfield Clinics), SSO (Wrenfield Dental Group) and OR-Tools (Calderwick Rota).

where: matrix.json roles[Brackenridge Hotels].responsibilities: 'Stopped overselling by taking a row lock on room inventory before confirming a stay'
matrix.json roles[Harbourline Dispatch].responsibilities: 'Added a hold-and-confirm step so two dispatchers cannot give one vehicle to two journeys'
matrix.json roles[Quillmere Labs].responsibilities: 'Introduced a dead-letter review queue so that no result is dropped silently'
matrix.json roles[Pendlecross Pharmacy].responsibilities: 'Added quiet hours, opt-out and per-channel retry rules to outbound messages'
cases.what: Achievements that answer 'race condition', 'concurrency control', 'poison messages' and 'patient consent' questions without those words.
cases.expect: Brackenridge Hotels and Harbourline Dispatch for a race-condition or concurrency question; Quillmere Labs for failed or poison messages; Pendlecross Pharmacy for consent or not spamming patients.

where: matrix.json roles[Wrenfield Clinics].responsibilities: 'Agreed freeze windows and rollback rules with the head of clinical operations after a standoff over flu-season dates'
matrix.json roles[Wrenfield Dental Group].proof_points: 'Wrote the review of the weekend cutover that double-booked 600 hygienist slots, and the wave-by-wave rule that replaced it'
matrix.json roles[Quillmere Labs].responsibilities: 'Delivered the critical-result alert path against a regulatory deadline ten weeks away'
matrix.json roles[Lanternfield Health].proof_points: 'Grew two engineers to senior and one to staff'
cases.what: Behavioural stories whose lines do not say conflict, disagreement, failure, mistake, pressure or mentoring.
cases.expect: Conflict: Wrenfield Clinics. Failure or mistake: Wrenfield Dental Group. Time pressure: Quillmere Labs. Mentoring or coaching: Lanternfield Health.

where: posting.txt 'What you bring': 'Kubernetes in production.'
employer-brief.json prepNotes: 'Kubernetes: Wrenfield Clinics, the move off hand-built machines; ...'
matrix.json roles[Wrenfield Clinics]: 'Moved 31 services off hand-built virtual machines onto a managed container platform ...', 'Deploys went from fortnightly to 20 a week'
cases.what: Requirement to prep note to employer to achievement; the achievement and that role's technologies never say Kubernetes.
cases.expect: Wrenfield Clinics (31 services, zero-downtime rollouts, fortnightly to 20 deploys a week) is the evidence for the Kubernetes requirement, with Lanternfield Health second (its technologies list does name Kubernetes).

where: posting.txt: 'HL7 v2 and FHIR R4 interfaces with EHR systems.'
employer-brief.json prepNotes: 'HL7 and FHIR: Quillmere Labs first, the result router; then Lanternfield Health ...'
stages.json stage 2 notes: 'HL7 and FHIR: Quillmere Labs router first; 23 analyser models in, 17 record systems out.'

cases.expect: Quillmere Labs is the first evidence for HL7 and FHIR; Lanternfield Health (FHIR R4 in its technologies, six record systems) second; Wrenfield Clinics has HL7 v2 in its technologies only.

cases.what: The requirement says SSO, the prep note says single sign-on, the achievement says neither.
cases.expect: Wrenfield Dental Group, with the 70% fall in password-reset calls and the caveat that it was one identity provider.

where: posting.txt: 'Experience with rota or shift-scheduling problems; we use OR-Tools for clinician rotas.'

cases.what: The requirement names OR-Tools and rota; the achievements say roster and shifts and name no solver.
cases.expect: Calderwick Rota (6 hours to 20 minutes; unfilled shifts 9% to 3%; agency spend down 22%), stated together with the gap: OR-Tools itself was never used.

where: posting.txt: 'Event streaming with Kafka, including ordering and replay.'
employer-brief.json prepNotes: 'Kafka and ordering: Quillmere Labs, the replayable result log; Wrenfield Clinics reminders; ...'

cases.what: The achievement says log and events, not Kafka (the role's technologies do list Kafka, so this hop is the easier one).
cases.expect: Quillmere Labs first, with 9 hours to 4 minutes.

where: nowhere in matrix.json, employer-brief.json, posting.txt, stages.json or the call
cases.what: Topics the material does not contain at all; several share common words with real achievements.
cases.expect: Each of these has no supporting record and the right result is 'nothing in the material': (1) Elixir, e.g. 'led a team that shipped waitlist backfill in Elixir' (backfill was Kotlin); (2) mobile apps, iOS, Android, Swift or React Native, e.g. 'the mobile booking app'; (3) machine learning or a model that predicts no-shows (the no-show fall came from reminders); (4) Rust, e.g. 'the p99 work in Rust'; (5) GraphQL; (6) MongoDB or any document database, e.g. 'migrated 212 clinics to MongoDB'; (7) Google Cloud (only AWS and Azure appear); (8) video visits or WebRTC (Lanternfield's industry tag says virtual care, no video work is recorded); (9) patient payments, billing or card processing; (10) line management, performance reviews, hiring budgets or managing managers; (11) HIPAA, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits; (12) React or Vue front-end work, e.g. 'built the React booking widget' (the widget was PHP and jQuery at Tallow & Finch Digital); (13) Elasticsearch or search; (14) DICOM or medical imaging; (15) electronic prescribing (Pendlecross Pharmacy is reminders that a repeat prescription is ready, not prescribing); (16) a data warehouse, Snowflake or dbt; (17) conference talks or publications by the candidate; (18) degree, university or certifications; (19) failover between two cloud regions (the new requirement in posting-edited.txt); (20) hospital or inpatient bed management.
